asanaImport.title: Import an Asana project
asanaImport.description: Bring a project over from Asana using its matching JSON and CSV exports. Your Asana project stays unchanged.
asanaImport.fileHelp: Choose both exports of the same project. Each file can be up to 10 MiB. Nothing is imported until you review the preview.
asanaImport.external: Keep unresolved external dependencies as source metadata
asanaImport.importing: Importing the project… this can take a minute. Please wait and keep this window open.
asanaImport.reviewHelp: Review the counts and warnings, then import. You can configure reports and project settings afterwards.
asanaImport.existing: This export was already imported. Open the existing project; no duplicate project will be created.
asanaImport.success: Your project is ready. Open it to review tasks, fields and reports.
asanaImport.sizeError: Each file must be no larger than 10 MiB. Export a smaller project or use the local import command.
asanaImport.accessError: Your session or workspace permissions changed. Sign in as the workspace owner and try again.
asanaImport.uncertainError: The import may have finished, but its answer did not arrive. Retry this same import to retrieve its result safely. Do not upload another copy.
asanaImport.projectRuleError: Some tasks in this export already belong to projects that keep every task in one project only, so they cannot also appear in the new project. Turn that rule off in the Project rules of those projects, then check the files again.
asanaImport.unmatchedTitle: Some people from Asana are not on the Members page
asanaImport.unmatchedHelp: Choose what to do with the tasks assigned to each of them, then check the files again. Or add them on the Members page with the same e-mail address as in Asana.
asanaImport.actionFor: What to do with the tasks of {{name}}
asanaImport.missingEmails: Not found on the Members page: {{emails}}.
asanaImport.mappingError: Every person in the export must already be on the Members page with the same e-mail address as in Asana. Add the missing teammates there, then check the files again.
asanaImport.reviewError: This export needs review: it may conflict with an existing import or current shared tasks, or need a preservation option. Check the original exports and the advanced options.
asanaImport.busyError: Another import is running. Wait for it to finish, then retry this import.
asanaImport.previewError: The files could not be checked. Make sure the JSON and CSV are matching Asana exports, review the advanced options, and try again.
asanaImport.applyError: The import could not finish. Retry this import; already imported tasks will be reused.
asanaImport.warningHistory: Exported comments, attachments and full Asana history are unavailable. Current hours do not create work logs.
asanaImport.warningLinked: Shared tasks keep their canonical data. Target project fields are display-only in linked rows.
asanaImport.warningMilestones: Milestones imported as ordinary tasks: {{count}}. Their original type remains in the source archive.
asanaImport.warningExternal: External dependency labels kept as source metadata: {{count}}. No dependency links are guessed.
asanaImport.warningUnknown: This import has an additional warning. Ask the local import operator to review the source before proceeding.
asanaImport.externalDependencyError: A task depends on work that is not in this export (for example another week or project). Open advanced options, turn on “Keep unresolved external dependencies as source metadata”, and check the files again. The labels are kept as notes; no links are guessed.
asanaImport.milestoneOptionError: The export contains milestones. Open advanced options, turn on “Import milestones as ordinary tasks”, and check the files again.
asanaImport.textBoundsError: A task name is empty, or a name or description is longer than Workloom allows. Check the export in Asana.
asanaImport.howTitle: How to get the two files from Asana
asanaImport.howOne: Open the project in Asana and click the arrow next to the project name.
asanaImport.howTwo: Choose Export/Print, then CSV. A file downloads.
asanaImport.howThree: Open the same menu again and choose JSON. A second file downloads.
asanaImport.howFour: Add your teammates to the Members page here first, using the e-mail addresses they have in Asana, so their tasks keep their owners.
asanaImport.wrongFiles: These files are not one JSON export and one CSV export of the same Asana project. Choose the file ending in .json and the file ending in .csv.
asanaImport.releaseRules: Turn the rule off and check again
asanaImport.releaseRulesHelp: This switches “one project only” off in the projects listed above. You can turn it back on in their Project rules afterwards.
asanaImport.leaveOut: Leave these tasks out of the new project
asanaImport.leaveOutHelp: Tasks that already exist in your other projects stay only there. They are not copied or duplicated, and everything else is imported.
asanaImport.skipShared: Leave out tasks that already exist in other projects

archive.archiveFailed: The project could not be archived. Reload the page and try again.
archive.restoreFailed: The project could not be restored. Reload the page and try again.
archive.emptyHelp: Archive a project from its Actions menu. It disappears from the lists but nothing is lost, and you can restore it here.
archive.summary: Archived projects stay out of the way. Restore one to use it again, or delete it permanently.
archive.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the project, every task that belongs to it, and their values, comments and history. Tasks that only appear in this project from elsewhere stay where they are. There is no undo.
archive.deleteConfirm: Type the project name to confirm
archive.deleteFailed: The project could not be deleted. Check the name and try again.
archive.deleteForbidden: Only an owner or an admin can delete a project permanently.
archive.ownerOnlyHint: Only owners and admins can delete projects permanently.
archive.archiveWarning: The project leaves the project lists and the sidebar. Nothing is deleted, and you can restore it any time from the Archive page.
archive.deleting: Deleting the project and its tasks… please wait
